note: Pure-CLI tool (no server/daemon), so the factory's live-auth probe is scoped out. The routing table (domains.json) is verified on every rebuild by d01; the 23 unit tests are re-run by d02; the folded front-end's own OS smoke suite (13 tests) is re-run by d03; and routing accuracy over the hand-labeled 25-case fixture (replay, zero-spend, gated at 0.8) is enforced by d04 — the standing guard that routing quality does not silently drift when descriptions or skills change. pytest_target overrides the factory's default 'tests/' because this repo keeps its tests at the root.
